title: Amazon Reviews

asins.title: ASINs or product URLs
asins.description: Verified UK example: ["https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B09G9FPHY6"]. Current US tests require sign-in and return no reviews. A URL selects its marketplace; bare ASINs use domain (default com). Only source-visible product-page samples, not full history or a guaranteed count. Each ASIN + marketplace is fetched and billed once. Blocked pages have a free error status.

domain.title: Marketplace
domain.description: Marketplace for bare ASINs; runtime default "com" means amazon.com, whose current tested review pages require sign-in. A full UK URL such as "https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B09G9FPHY6" selects co.uk automatically and ignores this field. The parser accepts 20 marketplace codes listed in the README; current anonymous availability is not guaranteed for all of them. Reviews retain the source language; no language filter or translation.

minRating.title: Only reviews at or below this rating
minRating.description: Star CEILING, not a floor: keeps only reviews rated at or BELOW this many stars, e.g. 2 = one- and two-star reviews only, 3 = three stars and below. 0 (default) = every rating. Use for "negative reviews", "complaints", "what do customers dislike". The filter selects within the visible product-page sample, so a negative-only run returns a few rows per product and none when no visible review is negative. Dropped reviews are never charged; the product row is still delivered.

verifiedOnly.title: Only verified purchases
verifiedOnly.description: true = keep only reviews Amazon marks as Verified Purchase. Default false (every review). Dropped reviews are never charged. Use for "verified purchase reviews only".

requireText.title: Only reviews with written text
requireText.description: true = drop rating-only reviews without written text before billing. Runtime default false; the first-call form prefills true for a useful text sample. Use for sentiment analysis or topic mining. Filtered reviews are never charged.

includeProductRow.title: Include a product row
includeProductRow.description: true (DEFAULT) = one extra row per product at $0.003 with its overall rating, ratings count, 5-to-1-star histogram (when Amazon shows it), title, brand, availability, image, feature bullets and reviews_visible. Keep it for "rating and review count for these ASINs" and catalogue-wide rating sweeps. Set false to pay for review rows only.

maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product
maxReviewsPerProduct.description: 0 (runtime default) = all source-visible reviews. The form prefills 3 for a small UK sample. N caps rows per product after free filters, in source order; fewer may be available. Three reviews cost at most $0.015, plus $0.003 if includeProductRow is true. Setting 1 still returns one eligible review plus the optional product row; it is not a product-only switch. No sort, date or only-new control; dedupe on review_id.

sessions.title: Parallel sessions
sessions.description: Parallel proxy sessions (one egress IP each), 1 to 16, e.g. 4 (default 4). More is faster for long ASIN lists; each session is paced separately.

perIp.title: Requests per second per IP
perIp.description: Requests per second per session, 0.1 to 2 (default 0.5). Amazon tolerates about 0.5/s per IP; faster causes captchas, not speed. Leave the default.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy defaults to {"useApifyProxy":true}; the run can retry transient blocks and escalate to residential routing. Rotation does not guarantee access when Amazon requires sign-in. The verified UK examples work with the default proxy setup. To request residential directly: {"useApifyProxy":true,"apifyProxyGroups":["RESIDENTIAL"]}. Input prices and billing rules are unchanged.

description: UK first call: {"asins":["https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B09G9FPHY6"],"maxReviewsPerProduct":3,"requireText":true}. US pages currently require sign-in and return no reviews. Only visible product-page samples, not full history. Review rows cost $0.005 each; includeProductRow defaults to true and adds a $0.003 product row. Filters run before billing. API defaults are unchanged.
